issues.description: The solution for Aufgabe 04 aliases the column regierungsbezirk to 'District' (SELECT regierungsbezirk AS District). The problem statement explicitly instructs students not to rename columns with AS unless requested, and the task asks to output the Regierungsbezirk name. This mismatch between the problem guidance and the solution's column name can confuse students and may cause automated column-name checks to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the alias and return the column name as requested (use SELECT regierungsbezirk, SUM(einwohner_w), SUM(einwohner_m) ...). Alternatively, if an alias is desired, update the problem statement to allow or require that specific alias so template, instructions, and solution match.

issues.description: The problem statement and tasks refer to the column/term 'regierungsbezirk' (the Regierungsbezirk name), but the solution query in solution_repository/aufgabe04.sql aliases this column to 'District' (SELECT regierungsbezirk AS District). This introduces a different identifier for the same conceptual entity across artifacts and conflicts with the instruction not to rename columns with AS, potentially confusing students who expect the original column name 'regierungsbezirk'.
issues.suggestedFix: Do not alias the column; keep the original column name used in the problem statement. Replace the SELECT line with: SELECT regierungsbezirk, SUM(einwohner_w), SUM(einwohner_m) FROM Gemeinde GROUP BY regierungsbezirk
